Record Class ConfigurationChange

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
io.micronaut.context.watch.ConfigurationChange
Record Components:
all - Whether everything is to be considered changed, as a full refresh does
changed - The keys whose value changed, was added or was removed
previous - The previous values of the changed keys, absent for keys that were added
current - The current values of the changed keys, absent for keys that were removed
initial - Whether this is the first batch of a watch, delivered when it is registered: everything is to be read as it is now, and all() holds
public record ConfigurationChange(boolean all, Set<String> changed, Map<String, @Nullable Object> previous, Map<String, @Nullable Object> current, boolean initial) extends Record
One batch of configuration changes, as a refresh computed it, or the first batch of a watch that asked for one, which describes the configuration as it is rather than a change.
Since:
5.3.0

    • touches

      public boolean touches(String prefix)
      Whether the change touches a prefix: the prefix itself, or a key below it at a dot boundary, or an entry of it in bracket form (prefix[0].key). Keys and prefixes are compared in a form where camel case, hyphens, dots and an environment variable's underscores all name the same property, since an environment variable stands for every dot and hyphen spelling at once.
      Parameters:
      prefix - The prefix, such as datasources.default
      Returns:
      True if a changed key is at or under the prefix, or everything changed

    • touchesAny

      Returns:
